squelch.prompt: Short burst of walkie-talkie radio squelch, a crisp static click

alert_chime.prompt: Two-tone electronic alert chime from a control room console, clean and urgent

all_clear.prompt: Soft, gentle descending two-note chime signaling all clear, calm and reassuring

sting_zombie.prompt: Low guttural zombie groan with shuffling feet

sting_vampire.prompt: Bat wings fluttering and a low sinister hiss

sting_werewolf.prompt: Long wolf howl under a full moon, distant and echoing

sting_banshee.prompt: Piercing mournful banshee wail fading into the wind

sting_witch_hex.prompt: Bubbling cauldron with a raspy witch cackle

sting_mummy.prompt: Sand pouring and a slow stone sarcophagus lid grinding open

sting_will_o_wisp.prompt: Ethereal glassy shimmer with soft twinkling tones over night marsh insects

sting_gremlin.prompt: Electrical sparks crackling with mischievous high-pitched chittering
